ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta pre-encryption recovery sabotage chain (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin)
ucs.description: Hunts the exact recovery-killing tool chain Black Basta's encryptor and its operators execute moments before T1486 file encryption: deleting volume shadow copies, disabling Windows boot recovery, and wiping the backup catalog. The combination of these specific commands within minutes on one host is documented in CISA AA24-131A and Mandiant UNC4393 reporting on Black Basta.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as tools values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process_name) as toolCount from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=30m | where toolCount >= 2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)` | rename Processes.* AS * | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Black Basta: chains vssadmin/wmic + bcdedit + wbadmin to nuke recovery just before ransomware drop (CISA AA24-131A).
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"   // strip machine-account noise (backup agents run as SYSTEM)
| where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe"      and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"   and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe"   and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(FileName),
            Tools  = make_set(FileName, 8),
            Cmds   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 16),
            Parents= make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8),
            First  = min(Timestamp),
            Last   = max(Timestamp)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 30m)
| where DistinctTools >= 2   // 2+ distinct recovery-killing tools in 30m = Black Basta encryptor signature
| order by First desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Black Basta pre-encryption recovery sabotage — Security 4688 view.
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where (NewProcessName endswith @"\vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wmic.exe"      and CommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\bcdedit.exe"   and (CommandLine has "recoveryenabled" or CommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy"))
     or (NewProcessName endswith @"\wbadmin.exe"   and CommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
| summarize DistinctTools = dcount(NewProcessName),
            Tools   = make_set(NewProcessName, 8),
            Cmds    = make_set(CommandLine, 16),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8),
            First   = min(TimeGenerated),
            Last    = max(TimeGenerated)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| where DistinctTools >= 2
| order by First desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Black Basta Pre-Encryption Recovery Sabotage Chain
id: 7c8d4e10-3a11-4b9e-9bba-2e8e62f8c5a1
status: experimental
description: Detects the vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy delete + bcdedit recovery disable + wbadmin catalog wipe combination Black Basta runs immediately before T1486 file encryption.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-131a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc4393-goes-gently-into-the-silentnight
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/09
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1485
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_vss:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'shadows'
      - 'shadowcopy'
  selection_bcd:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'recoveryenabled no'
      - 'recoveryenabled No'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures'
  selection_wb:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Backup-product cleanup tasks (whitelist by signed parent path)
  - DR-test runbooks executed by IT operations
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@CommandLine:*vssadmin* AND @CommandLine:*delete* AND @CommandLine:*shadows*) OR (@CommandLine:*wmic* AND @CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*delete*) OR (@CommandLine:*bcdedit* AND (@CommandLine:*recoveryenabled* OR @CommandLine:*bootstatuspolicy*)) OR (@CommandLine:*wbadmin* AND @CommandLine:*delete* AND @CommandLine:*catalog*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| (ImageFileName=/\\vssadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+shadows/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wmic\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/shadowcopy\s+delete/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(recoveryenabled\s+no|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures)/i)
  OR (ImageFileName=/\\wbadmin\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/delete\s+catalog/i)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(field=ImageFileName, distinct=true, as=toolCount), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])])
| toolCount >= 2

ucs.title: [LLM] Black Basta PsExec ransomware fan-out from a single staging host (PSEXESVC across many ADMIN$ targets)
ucs.description: Detects Black Basta's preferred lateral deployment pattern: from a single beachhead (often the DC or a file server they've owned with stolen domain admin credentials), they push the encryptor to every reachable host by remote-installing the PSEXESVC service via SMB. Joins PSEXESVC spawning by services.exe to the inbound network logon to identify the originating staging host and the victim fan-out count.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as proc values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="services.exe" AND (Processes.process_name="PSEXESVC.exe" OR Processes.process="*PSEXESVC*") by Processes.dest _time span=30m | bin _time span=30m | stats dc(Processes.dest) as victimCount values(Processes.dest) as victims values(cmds) as cmdSamples min(_time) as firstTime by _time | where victimCount >= 3 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Black Basta lateral deploy: PSEXESVC spawned by services.exe across multiple hosts in one window, traced back to the staging origin via inbound network logon.
let TimeWindow = 30m;
let PsExecSpawn =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "services.exe"
    | where FileName =~ "PSEXESVC.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has "PSEXESVC"
    | project SpawnTime = Timestamp, TargetHost = DeviceName, TargetCmd = ProcessCommandLine, TargetLogonId = InitiatingProcessLogonId, AccountName;
let RemoteLogons =
    DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)   // 3 = network/SMB, 10 = RDP (operators sometimes RDP in then PsExec out)
    | project LogonTime = Timestamp, TargetHost = DeviceName, AccountName, LogonId, RemoteIP, RemoteDeviceName;
PsExecSpawn
| join kind=inner RemoteLogons on TargetHost, $left.TargetLogonId == $right.LogonId
| summarize VictimCount = dcount(TargetHost),
            Victims    = make_set(TargetHost, 50),
            Accounts   = make_set(AccountName, 8),
            Cmds       = make_set(TargetCmd, 8),
            FirstSeen  = min(SpawnTime)
        by RemoteIP, RemoteDeviceName, bin(SpawnTime, TimeWindow)
| where VictimCount >= 3   // one source pushing PSEXESVC to 3+ hosts in 30m = Black Basta fan-out, not admin ops
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Same detection on Security 4688 (PSEXESVC spawn) + 4624 (network logon that delivered it).
let TimeWindow = 30m;
let PsExecSpawn =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where ParentProcessName endswith @"\services.exe"
    | where NewProcessName endswith @"\PSEXESVC.exe" or CommandLine has "PSEXESVC"
    | project SpawnTime = TimeGenerated, TargetHost = Computer, TargetCmd = CommandLine, TargetLogonId, AccountName = SubjectUserName;
let RemoteLogons =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | where EventID == 4624
    | where LogonType in (3, 10)
    | project LogonTime = TimeGenerated, TargetHost = Computer, IpAddress, WorkstationName, TargetLogonId;
PsExecSpawn
| join kind=inner RemoteLogons on TargetHost, TargetLogonId
| summarize VictimCount = dcount(TargetHost),
            Victims    = make_set(TargetHost, 50),
            Accounts   = make_set(AccountName, 8),
            Cmds       = make_set(TargetCmd, 8),
            FirstSeen  = min(SpawnTime)
        by IpAddress, WorkstationName, bin(SpawnTime, TimeWindow)
| where VictimCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 @ParentProcessName:(*\\services.exe OR *\\SERVICES.EXE) (@NewProcessName:(*\\PSEXESVC.exe OR *\\psexesvc.exe OR *\\PSEXESVC.EXE) OR @CommandLine:(*PSEXESVC* OR *psexesvc*))

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/services\.exe/i ImageFileName=/\\PSEXESVC\.exe$/i
| groupBy([bin(_time, 30m)], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=victimCount), collect(ComputerName, as=victims), collect(CommandLine)])
| victimCount >= 3
